title: The Guard Counted 201
summary: A boy who counts everything exposes the extra person at the sunset roll call. A missing shadow leads him to count his best friend’s freckles again.
frame_0: Tam and his freckled friend Mabel stand between the front ranks of the town. Captain Brill points from the gate arch beneath a red 201 counter.
package_differences: Uses Jake’s November 22 sponsor update, with the Flashloop code at top right, the handle at top left and a five-second spoken phone ending photographed with Tam and Mabel.
